subject: Post-demo stakeholder journey & champion enablement — action plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Arman Shah <arman.shah@finraxi.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@finraxi.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo follow-up: stakeholder map & next steps

Thanks again for carving out time this morning — Arman, appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key decision criteria we heard today:
- Latency: P95 < 200ms for typical user flows
- Data isolation: customer-controlled keys & VPC model preferred
- Auditability: token-level logs + 90d retention for initial pilot
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.015/token effective for peak workloads

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm economic buyer and legal/procurement owners so we can tailor the MAUP and PO language (see attached worksheet).
2) Security packet: Liam or security lead — can you confirm the right contact and whether a SOC2 + network diagram will suffice? We can send a short security one-pager.
3) Mutual action plan: propose procurement kickoff week of Aug 1, pilot in Aug, decision by end of August. If that looks off, tell us which dates work.

Champion enablement suggestions (we can put these into a one-pager for Priya/CFO):
- 2-slide ROI summary (revenue ops uplift + cost avoidance)
- Sample runbook snippet showing fallback + SLA guarantees
- Procurement-friendly pricing scenarios (committed vs burst)

Attachments: [Attachment: finraxi-maup-worksheet.xlsx (28KB)]

I’ll wait for confirmation of contacts; Marissa, Ben — can you please start a short ROI one-pager and pricing scenarios respectively? If you want, I’ll draft recommended language for the PO and procurement lane.

Cheers,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Arman Shah <arman.shah@finraxi.com>

Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: stakeholder map & next steps

Thanks Rishi — good summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Priya Rao (CFO) will own financial sign-off.
- Security lead: Liam O'Connor (Head of InfoSec) is the right contact for SOC2 / network diagram / incident response Qs.
- Legal/procurement: Sally Nguyen (procurement lead) will coordinate contract terms and PO flow.

Timeline that looks realistic for us: procurement kickoff target Aug 1 -> 2 weeks for security review -> procurement/contracting by Aug 20 -> pilot start Aug 25. We have an internal budget window the first week of Sept, but we want procurement wrapped before then.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Please send SOC2 report + brief answers to the network segmentation question (do you support VPC peering / private endpoints?).
- A short ROI summary directed at the CFO would be helpful — highlight topline ops savings and net cost delta vs current infra.

I’ve looped Liam and Sally on this thread. Liam, if you want to break out a separate channel for deeper technical Qs (we have a backlog of specific security controls), that’s fine.

Best,
Arman Shah
Head of Platform Strategy, Finraxi Financial
arman.shah@finraxi.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Demo follow-up: stakeholder map & next steps (internal owners + deliverables)

Forwarding Arman's note — internal-only plan below. DO NOT include external recipients in drafts until we have the final one-pager.

High-level ask: we need three short artifacts by EOD Mon 7/17 so Rishi can send to Priya/Liam/Sally: 
1) CFO one-pager (Marissa) — 1 page, senior-friendly, include 3 quantified impact bullets + recommended procurement ask (term and commitment).
2) Pricing scenarios + suggested PO language (Ben) — committed monthly vs pay-as-you-go with burst cap; include example line items and a suggested sentence for procurement to include in the PO.
3) Security quicksheet (Evelyn) — 2 pages max: SOC2 summary, network diagram excerpt, data flows, answers to likely Yes/No controls for their standard RFP. Attach the redwood-security-quicksheet.pdf as source.

Notes on tone and content: keep everything concise — CFO wants numbers; Liam will want clear callouts for encryption, KMS/HSM, audit log retention, and network isolation options. For procurement, include our standard 30-day invoice + PO acceptance language and a sample SOW outline for a pilot.

I'll assemble the MAUP worksheet into a shared Drive folder once the pieces are ready: https://drive.company/redwood/finraxi-demo-notes (I will add you).

Deliverable owners and checkpoints:
- Marissa: draft CFO one-pager by EOD Mon 7/17 -> I will review Tue morning.
- Ben: pricing scenarios and PO language by Mon 7/17 -> share link in thread.
- Evelyn: security quicksheet by Mon 7/17 -> attach PDF and call out any red flags.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-security-quicksheet.pdf (42KB)]

Thanks team — short and tactical here. I’ll coordinate the external send once we have the docs.

Rishi
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
